content.comment_body: Hello, I am facing an issue with a page I created. When I access the application and enter a value in an input field using a computer, it works as expected (submission confirmed). However, when I try using my mobile phone, it doesn't work properly—the cursor jumps to another field and submission fails. I've tried multiple phones without success.
Is your phone running Android OS?
That may be the reason. The virtual keyboard on Android usually doesn't have an Enter key, right?
There are four input fields on my page, but there's one specific field that can't be submitted on mobile, while on the computer it works fine.
Yes, and since this is the last input field, you can't move out of it using the Tab key.
If I submit seconds, it works (submission confirmed), but selecting minutes doesn't work.
It doesn't matter whether it's the first or second field—the issue persists. When I go back to seconds, it's usable.
The issue is specifically with the 'minutes' field. On desktop, it works normally.
As mentioned, the problem stems from Android OS because its virtual keyboard lacks an Enter key.
However, for the seconds field, if I enter a number like "3" and press Enter on the Android keypad, the server accepts the submission.
How can I resolve this issue?
Hi, when you edit a field, a checkbox appears, which you must use to submit the value. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that form submission behaves differently on desktop computers and Android mobile devices. While all fields can be submitted correctly on desktop, the 'minutes' input field does not work on Android, apparently due to the lack of an Enter key on the virtual keyboard. This issue leads to confusion and incomplete submissions when using mobile devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect uniform and dependable form behavior on both desktop and Android mobile devices, allowing hassle-free entry and submission of data for all input fields.
